Interface ReactiveGeoOperations<K,M>

public interface ReactiveGeoOperations<K,M>
用于地理命令的响应式 Redis 操作。
Since:
2.0
Author:
Mark Paluch，Christoph Strobl
See Also:
  • Redis 文档：Geo 命令
